title: A receipt
summary: Left and right alignment, decimals, a computed total.
hints: `%-10s` left-aligns a string in 10 characters (the `-` flag); `%5d` right-aligns an int; `%8.2f` is a double in 8 characters with 2 decimals.
For the Total line print an empty string `""` with `%5s` in the quantity column.
